ai_summary: **Executive Summary**  Deepak Nitrite Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Deepak Phenolics Limited, has internally invested ₹120 Crores into another wholly-owned subsidiary, Deepak Chem Tech Limited (DCTL), by subscribing to 9% Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares. This capital infusion is intended to strengthen DCTL's financial base for ongoing project expenses and general corporate purposes, supporting its expanding chemical manufacturing operations. As this is an internal group reallocation of funds between wholly-owned entities, there are no red flags, external dilution, or changes to the ultimate ownership structure of the consolidated group.
